description: Defines the TemplateBoolean class for rendering boolean fields in SuiteCRM, including methods for editing, searching, and displaying details of boolean fields.

classes.name: TemplateBoolean
classes.description: A class extending TemplateField to handle boolean field rendering and logic in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates template variables for editing a boolean field, including help text and checked state.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Generates template variables for searching a boolean field based on request input.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Generates template variables for displaying a boolean field in detail view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns the same output as get_xtpl_edit for list view.
